description: Real quotes from real investors and financial thinkers. Used as seed material for scripts.

quotes.text: Be fearful when others are greedy, and greedy when others are fearful.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.text: Price is what you pay. Value is what you get.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.text: Rule No. 1: Never lose money. Rule No. 2: Never forget Rule No. 1.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.text: The stock market is a device for transferring money from the impatient to the patient.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.text: Risk comes from not knowing what you are doing.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.text: It is only when the tide goes out that you discover who has been swimming naked.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.text: The first rule of compounding: Never interrupt it unnecessarily.
quotes.author: Charlie Munger

quotes.text: Show me the incentive and I will show you the outcome.
quotes.author: Charlie Munger

quotes.text: It is remarkable how much long-term advantage people like us have gotten by trying to be consistently not stupid, instead of trying to be very intelligent.
quotes.author: Charlie Munger

quotes.text: Earn with your mind, not your time.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: You are not going to get rich renting out your time.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: All the returns in life come from compound interest. Whether in money, relationships, or knowledge.
quotes.author: Naval Ravikant

quotes.text: He who lives by the crystal ball will eat shattered glass.
quotes.author: Ray Dalio

quotes.text: Cash is the worst investment over time.
quotes.author: Ray Dalio

quotes.text: The biggest mistake investors make is to believe that what happened in the recent past is likely to persist.
quotes.author: Ray Dalio

quotes.text: Do not look for the needle in the haystack. Just buy the haystack.
quotes.author: Jack Bogle

quotes.text: The single greatest edge an investor can have is a long-term orientation.
quotes.author: Seth Klarman

quotes.text: Know what you own, and know why you own it.
quotes.author: Peter Lynch

quotes.text: More money has been lost trying to anticipate corrections than in corrections themselves.
quotes.author: Peter Lynch

quotes.text: It is not whether you are right or wrong, but how much money you make when you are right and how much you lose when you are wrong.
quotes.author: George Soros

quotes.text: The four most expensive words in the English language are: this time it is different.
quotes.author: John Templeton

quotes.text: The investor's chief problem, and even his worst enemy, is likely to be himself.
quotes.author: Benjamin Graham

quotes.text: Being too far ahead of your time is indistinguishable from being wrong.
quotes.author: Howard Marks

quotes.text: Never invest in the present. The present is well known. You have to look two years ahead.
quotes.author: Stanley Druckenmiller

quotes.text: The most important investment you can make is in yourself.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett
